issue.title: Game mode generated NPC/background/illustration prompts lost negative-prompt and species safeguards

coreClaim: Game asset generation forwards per-kind negative prompts and preserves NPC species cues in portrait prompts; after merging current refactor, the branch removes duplicate Rust type aliases so the target baseline compiles.

preflight.details: Searched open and closed PRs for #2137 and title keywords; no direct existing fix PR or local issue-2137 worktree was present before work started.

reproduction.evidence: Before the fix, the proof script reported forwardsNegativePrompt=false and all three game negative prompt constants plus both portrait species safeguard strings missing from src/features/modes/game/api/game-api.ts.

verification.evidence: After the fix, the proof script reported forwardsNegativePrompt=true, all three game negative prompt constants present, and both non-human preservation and human-default portrait rule strings present.
edgeCases: Portrait negative prompt includes duplicated-face and four-portrait blockers.
Background negative prompt blocks people/characters and multiple frames.
Illustration negative prompt blocks unrelated characters and character sheets.
Non-human descriptions such as a stone golem, black cat, and red fox get the species-preservation rule.
A human NPC named Raven, a fox-masked/raven-haired human description, a wolf-cloak costume, and a human named Spirit stay under the human/humanoid default rule instead of becoming animal subjects.
An explicit non-human name such as Talking Cat still receives the species-preservation rule when description details are omitted.
Tag-format portrait prompts retain the species safeguard text.
verification.focusedTestEvidence: 6 Vitest cases passed for negative prompts, request payload forwarding, non-human description preservation, plain/color-marked species positives, human-name and animal-themed descriptor negative controls, explicit non-human name handling, and tag-format safeguards.
verification.laneCheckEvidence: tsc -b passed after the focused change.
verification.visualProof: Non-UI request-building bug; proof is the actual terminal output from the before/after source proof script and focused Vitest run.
verification.rustMergeCheckEvidence: cargo check passed after removing duplicate LorebookEntryAtomicRows and LorebookFolderDeleteAtomicRows aliases introduced by the current refactor base.
verification.baselineEvidence: pnpm check passed after the final diff, including line endings, architecture, frontend typecheck, Rust check, docs, discovery, launcher safety, and unused-code checks.

riskClaimMatrix.coreClaim: Game asset generation restores prompt safeguards without changing storage behavior, provider credentials, or generated asset persistence; duplicate Rust storage type aliases were removed after merging the current refactor base.
